posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
danmarshall14:

Plus I love Vengeance but it definitely would be stellar with more variety in the villain department.

One more set of five villains would be just about right too, to give you a great amount of combinations when sitting down to a Vengeance-style game.

I wonder if, thematically, it would be awkward though.  Vengeance is the Baron and his four buddies, assembled specifically to deliver the Baron's revenge.  If a second expansion had another five villains who, I assume, would have their own reason for teaming up, would it make sense to mix the two groups together, or would it end up feeling like a herd of cats with multiple uncomplimentary motivations who were all fighting at the same time, but not necessarily together?

My current speculation:

2 more expansions after WotC. 1 normal expansion and then the final Mega expansion.

Next normal expansion will be themed around Evil Organizations in the SotM universe. Namely FILTER, RevoCorp, and the Dragon Clans.

Unity Bunker AbZero and Scholar will have their nemisis villains here. Environments will be a ninja dojo and FILTER HQ.

Heros? Well…that is the sticky wicket right now. I'v said for a long time that it wouldn't surprise me to have a few villains turn into hero decks.

The Operative would make perfect sense given my theme speculation and her appearance in Tactics, having her join the Blue Dragon clans along with DW Fixer in order to take down Zhu Long and the Red Dragon clans. The Red Masked assasin that sticks a blade into DW Fixer could be from that red clan as well. But thats all speculation from artwork we have all seen.

Matriarch could become one as well, judging by the appearance of her being attacking by a as-yet-to-be-revealed villain in Parse's deck (Adam has never shown a villain fighting another villain in any card art to date). Maybe the group of villains (kinda resemble the sinister 6) as seen on Setbacks cards are actually her old friends from the "Dead Poets Society" and she turns a new leaf to help take them on?

 

It's hard to speculate what the final Mega expansion will be, but it surely will be a "Final Battle" themed culmination of all the storylines. I highly doubt it will be the same format as Vengeance. The format Vengeance took (5 heros, 1 Super Villain team) was based upon the story it told. The Final Battle expansion will probably have a brand new format for playing SotM that fits with the story it is trying to tell. Card art for WotC might give us a clearer hint as to whats coming, so we will just have to wait and see!
